sources.name: UK DSIT on gov.uk: Cyber Essentials management information

summary: The UK government's Cyber Essentials management information page was updated on 25 November 2026. It says 64,146 Cyber Essentials certificates have been awarded over the past year, split into 48,323 at CE level and 15,823 at CE+. The page also says organisations with Cyber Essentials are 92% less likely to make a claim on their cyber insurance.
title: UK government publishes Cyber Essentials figures: 64,146 certificates awarded over the past year
